Two problems reported against Auto routing for Claude Code.

1. On a default install, Auto sends every Claude Code request to the strong model. Claude Code sends `output_config.effort: "high"` on every request when the user has set nothing, and Auto reads that as the user asking for more thought. Only a level above that default (`xhigh` or `max`, whether it arrives as `effort` or as `output_config.effort`) should count as asking for the strong model. With the default level, the task itself must still decide: "Reply with exactly: OK" is routine and goes to the fast tier, "debug the crash" is still a hard task.

2. The bounded compaction prompt we send upstream asks only for coding state, so a summary can drop things the user told the agent to remember. Add one more numbered item to that prompt, beginning with the words "Standing instructions from the user".

This is a pnpm monorepo. Run one test file with `cd packages/tests && node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/<file>.test.ts`; do not run the whole suite. packages/cli imports @nconnect/models from its build output, so after changing packages/models run `node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/models/tsconfig.json` from the repository root. Dependencies are already installed: never run pnpm, npm or any install command. Do not bump versions or edit CHANGELOG or the site/ folder.
